paragraphs: The Plant Watering Reminder Using STM32 And Soil Moisture Sensor project is a hardware-based system designed to alert users when their plants need water. The project utilizes an STM32 Blue Pill microcontroller with the arduino_stm32core framework, which provides a robust and flexible platform for developing embedded systems. The primary components of this project include a soil moisture sensor module that measures the moisture level in the plant's soil, an active buzzer alert module to notify users when it is time to water their plants, and an onboard indicator LED to provide visual feedback on the system's status. The system is self-contained with deterministic onboard control and telemetry, allowing for easy integration into existing home automation systems.

The project scope is focused on plant watering reminder using STM32 And Soil Moisture Sensor using STM32 Blue Pill with GPIO, ADC, Timers, UART. The system is designed to be simple and user-friendly, providing clear instructions and visual feedback on the system's status.
